name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 53 - Am 140
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 53 a. Insists on the need to allocate Union funds to strengthening repatriation measures and securing the Union’s external borders in order to ensure a more effective and consistent management of the challenges posed by immigration; demands that sufficient funds be allocated for the construction and reinforcement of physical barriers at the Union’s external borders;
